title: EPA AirNow Real-Time Ground Sensor Network Data (Discontinued Nodes)
summary: Hourly PM2.5, ozone, and NO2 readings from thousands of EPA and state-operated monitoring stations, with hundreds of nodes decommissioned since 2020 due to budget cuts and the network's active contraction.

title: USGS Streamflow Gauging Station Records (Decommissioned Stations)
summary: Continuous river stage and discharge measurements from USGS stream gauges that have been shut down since the 1980s due to federal and state funding losses, representing gaps in the national hydrological record.

title: NOAA GOES Geostationary Satellite Full-Disk Imagery Archive (Pre-2017)
summary: Full-disk Earth imagery from legacy GOES satellites at 30-minute intervals, with older archives partially lost or degraded as NOAA migrated to GOES-R series infrastructure.

title: Landsat 1–3 Multispectral Scanner System Archive (1972–1983)
summary: Earliest multispectral satellite land-cover imagery from NASA/USGS Landsat missions, with significant portions on degraded tape media never fully digitized before physical deterioration.

title: Caltrans PeMS Highway Loop Detector Historical Archives (Discontinued Sensors)
summary: 30-second vehicle count and occupancy readings from embedded highway induction loops across California, with legacy detector records being lost as aging infrastructure is replaced by non-backward-compatible radar systems.

title: NOAA National Water Level Observation Network Discontinued Station Records
summary: Hourly sea-level and tidal measurements from NOAA tide gauges removed from operation since the 1990s, creating gaps in long-baseline coastal sea-level trend records.

title: European Seismic Network Analog Waveform Archive (Pre-Digital Era)
summary: Seismic waveform data recorded on paper and film by European national seismograph networks prior to digital conversion, with institutional custody gaps causing ongoing loss as originating agencies dissolve or reorganize.

title: UK Local Authority CCTV Footage Archives (31-Day Rolling Deletion)
summary: Continuous public-space video surveillance from approximately 1.85 million cameras operated by UK local councils, overwritten on a rolling 28–31 day retention cycle mandated by GDPR and police guidance.

title: Bruitparif Paris Urban Noise Monitoring Network Historical Records
summary: Continuous decibel and spectral noise measurements from the Paris metropolitan noise sensor network, with early-generation node data being lost as the system undergoes hardware refresh without full legacy migration.

title: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Daily NO2 Column Density Swath Archive
summary: Daily global tropospheric nitrogen dioxide column measurements from ESA's Sentinel-5P satellite, with near-real-time products deleted on rolling windows while the definitive offline product archive faces long-term ESA budget uncertainty.

title: Chicago Array of Things Urban Sensor Node Data
summary: Multi-parameter urban environmental and pedestrian sensing data from 500 nodes deployed across Chicago by Argonne National Laboratory and the City of Chicago, with data collection effectively terminated after 2022 and archive access degrading.

title: Pre-NEXRAD US Weather Radar and Rawinsonde Network Archive (WSR-57/WSR-74)
summary: Historical upper-air and radar reflectivity data from legacy US weather surveillance radar networks operated before NEXRAD deployment, with physical media deterioration causing progressive loss at NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information.

title: Barcelona Sentilo Smart City Sensor Platform Historical Archive
summary: City-wide environmental, mobility, and infrastructure sensor streams collected by Barcelona's Sentilo IoT platform, with multi-year archives at risk as the platform undergoes successive political administrations with inconsistent archiving mandates.

title: ICESat-1 GLAS Ice Sheet Laser Altimetry Archive (2003–2009)
summary: Laser altimetry measurements of polar ice sheet elevation from NASA's ICESat-1 GLAS instrument, with data products archived at NSIDC but derived gridded records being deprecated as the community migrates exclusively to ICESat-2.

title: Transport for London Oyster Card Aggregate Station Flow Records
summary: Hourly aggregated entry and exit counts derived from contactless Oyster card tap events at all London Underground stations, held by TfL with inconsistent historical retention policies and no statutory archival obligation.

title: EPA RadNet Nationwide Radiation Monitoring Network Historical Archive
summary: Continuous gamma radiation and airborne particulate readings from EPA's 140-station RadNet network, with pre-2006 analog monitor archives incompletely digitized and decommissioned station histories being lost.
